description: Write text (max 5 MB) to a file in the local Proton Drive sync folder; no Proton login needed. Requires PROTON_DRIVE_SYNC_PATH; the desktop app must be running to sync it to the cloud. Creates parent directories locally. Overwriting an existing file needs the user's approval, which the server asks for itself. For binary content use drive_upload. The server asks the user to approve this itself when the file already exists (it would be overwritten).

confirmed.description: Optional and ignored: the server asks the user to approve this itself. You do not need to send it.

content.description: UTF-8 text content to write. The file will be created or overwritten.

path.description: Absolute remote Drive path of the file to write (must start with '/'). /my-files/<rest> maps to <PROTON_DRIVE_SYNC_PATH>/<rest>; only /my-files is synced, other Drive roots are rejected. A path not starting with a Drive root is taken relative to the sync folder. E.g. /my-files/notes.txt

name: drive_write_file
title: Write synced text file
